statement: The register ratchet and the findings ratchet hold a run to the right base. A pull request is held to its own target branch (origin/development for a pull request into development, origin/main for one into main, a promotion snapshot included), so a rename that development already carries is not read against a main that is behind it. A push is held to the tip it replaced (the workflow hands it github.event.before as GATE_BASE_BEFORE), because the pushed commit itself would be a base of nothing; with no usable earlier tip (zero, not a sha, not in the clone) it falls back to origin/main. A local run, the nightly run and a manual run are held to origin/main, and an explicit --base always wins. The gate step passes no --base of its own, and the choice is a function with the environment as its argument, tested for each event.
